summary: Tested MedStore MVP end-to-end. Backend: 15/15 pytest passing covering auth (admin+user), JWT guards, medicine CRUD, free-plan 10-limit (402), dashboard stats, payments submit/list/bank-details, admin approve/reject/grant/revoke, admin stats, and OCR /api/ocr/extract (200 with {medicines:[...]} structure on a synthetic receipt image via GPT-5.2 vision through emergentintegrations). Frontend (mobile viewport): login, register, dashboard stats, add medicine, inventory listing + filter, membership payment submit, admin login and Admin panel Payments & Users tabs all functional with correct data-testids.

issues: Uses browser-default native date input (mm/dd/yyyy) instead of the shadcn Calendar/DatePicker component that is already available in /components/ui. Consider swapping to shadcn Calendar for a consistent, mobile-friendly UX.

action_items: (Low priority / polish) Replace native <input type=date> on Add/Edit medicine with shadcn Calendar component for consistent UX.
(Nice-to-have) On successful admin login, consider redirecting admins directly to /admin instead of / (currently lands on dashboard, user clicks 'Admin' in header).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is single-file ~640 lines — acceptable for MVP but should be split into routers (auth, medicines, payments, admin, ocr) as it grows.
Free-plan limit check in POST /api/medicines uses count_documents before insert — has a minor race condition under high concurrency; fine for MVP.
/api/ocr/extract returns cleaned medicines but does NOT auto-insert into DB; UI must POST them individually — correct, and good that free-plan limit is also enforced at OCR time.
MongoDB _id correctly excluded in all find queries via projection {'_id': 0}.
JWT_EXPIRE_HOURS defaults to 720h (30 days) — acceptable. JWT_SECRET fallback 'fallback-secret' should be removed once .env JWT_SECRET is guaranteed set in production.
expiry_alert_loop runs every 24h from startup — acceptable for MVP but note it sends per-user email every day even if already alerted (no dedupe).
test_credentials: admin@medstore.com / Admin@12345 (seeded). Test users registered dynamically.
seed_data_creation: Each test run registers TEST_user_<uuid>@example.com, creates TEST_-prefixed medicines and TXN_* payments. Medicines are cleaned up within tests; test users & payment records remain in DB (acceptable for MVP).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All APIs and core UI flows verified working. OCR integration (openai/gpt-5.2 via emergentintegrations) is live and returned 200 on a synthetic Pillow-generated receipt. Frontend testids: login-*-input/btn, register-*-input/btn, add-name/batch/expiry/qty/submit (NO -input/-btn suffix), inventory-filter/search/sort, edit-name/batch/expiry/qty/save, pay-ref/submit/note, copy-upi, tab-payments/tab-users. Date inputs are native browser pickers.
